x: MacMullen who had been delayed 60 yards through enforced attention to his shorts began to feel the effect of his effort and dropped away. Fish, walking strongly was the next ahead of Knifton who did not overtake him until the four miles point had been reached.

So far I have steered clear of the fate of some of our notorious 880 or rather 820 "runners," but when we see the performances of MacMullen and Tommy Green, we must admit that there is something in married life after all.
MacMullen was our “star” turn on this occasion. for after walking with fine judgment he finished up in fourth place, while Rickards, after making a great effort in the last five miles was 7th with E.
